label: 8-ch 1U Lite NVR with 8-port PoE
description: Dahua NVR4208-8P-4KS3 is a 1U 8-channel 4K Lite recorder with two HDD bays, eight 10/100 Mbps PoE ports (IEEE 802.3af/at) and one gigabit RJ45 uplink for the LAN.

poe.note: Vendor spec table, PoE Port: "8 ports, 10/100 Mbps, IEEE 802.3 af/at"; Power Consumption: "Total output power of PoE is 130 W, the maximum output power of a single port is 25.5 W". The 130 W is nearly twice the 72 W of its 4KS3 sibling NVR2108HS-8P and is what buys 802.3at on all eight ports. Read 2026-11-20 (200, 524,439 B, server-rendered).

notes: PoE out: all eight camera ports source 802.3af/at at up to 25.5 W each from a 130 W total budget; 8 x 25.5 W = 204 W of ceiling, so the supply - not the port count - is the limit. The eight PoE ports sit on the NVR's own camera subnet with DHCP served by the recorder, so a camera is not routable from the LAN unless the uplink is bridged.
